title: Farmer leaders hold sit-in outside locked Sugarcane Institute in Lucknow
seoTitle: Lucknow BKU sit-in at Sugarcane Institute

tea.why: Protesters held a sit-in after finding the Sugarcane Institute gates locked ahead of their scheduled meeting.
tea.want: Demanding higher sugarcane prices, clearance of cane dues, proper paddy procurement, and fair land compensation.
tea.changed: Oct 22: BKU leader Rakesh Tikait and supporters staged a sit-in outside Ganna Bhawan in Lucknow.

summary: Farmer leaders, including Bharatiya Kisan Union spokesperson Rakesh Tikait, held a sit-in outside Gate No. 1 of the Sugarcane Institute (Ganna Bhawan) in the Dali Bagh area of Lucknow on Thursday. The protest occurred after protesters arrived to make arrangements for a scheduled meeting and found the institute's gates locked. The demonstrators raised slogans and sat outside the premises for several hours, warning that they would continue their protest overnight if access was denied. Key demands raised by the farmers include increased sugarcane prices, immediate clearance of pending cane dues by sugar mills, proper functioning of paddy procurement centres, higher compensation for land acquired for development projects, and a legal guarantee for minimum support prices. According to sources cited in reports, the administration later started the process of opening the gate, which was unlocked at around 8 pm.
demands: Increase sugarcane prices to ₹500-600 per quintal
Immediate clearance of pending cane dues by sugar mills
Proper functioning of paddy procurement centres
Higher circle rate and compensation for land acquisition
response: Police force was deployed on the spot. Officials stated that the situation was under control and that permission for the upcoming panchayat was being examined.

updates.text: BKU leader Rakesh Tikait and fellow farmers staged a sit-in outside the locked Sugarcane Institute in Lucknow.
According to BKU district president Alok Varma, the institute gates were opened at around 8 pm following the protest.
